declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The settlement resulted from arm’s-length, confidential negotiations with defense counsel. Class relief and attorneys’ fees were negotiated concurrently; fees were not deferred until after agreement on class relief. The resulting agreement provides a $30 million class fund distributed automatically to identified members, plus up to $5 million in separately paid, court-approved fees and expenses. There is no clear-sailing provision, and any fees the Court does not award will benefit the class rather than revert to Brightline. I do not disclose the parties’ confidential mediation communications.
